title: The Maid
author: Nita Prose
summary: Molly Gray loves her work as a hotel maid and its rules and routines. Then she finds a guest dead in his suite and becomes the main suspect in a case she barely understands.
readIf: you like cosy-leaning mysteries with a distinctive, kind narrator.
skipIf: you want a gritty, procedural investigation, because the tone here is light and fairly gentle.

pairings.reason: Another warm, funny mystery in which unlikely people end up solving a crime.
Another story of a socially isolated woman whose odd outlook turns out to be a strength.
A tender novel about a lonely person slowly letting others in.
